title: DIR-051: Strict XAMPP Server Initiation & Prohibition of Background Server Spawns
spec:
### 1. MANDATE & OPERATIONAL INVARIANT
All web, API, reverse proxy, and database servers must strictly be initiated and hosted via XAMPP (D:\xampp). Spawning detached or rogue background server processes (e.g. background node index.js, background nodemon, background vite) is strictly prohibited to eliminate port (80, 443, 3306, 8080) and resource conflicts.

### 2. ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA
- AC-1: All servers run strictly under XAMPP (Apache ports 80/443, MySQL port 3306).
- AC-2: Zero unmanaged background server processes.
- AC-3: Bridge CLI provides first-class bridge xampp status/start/stop server management.
- AC-4: Developer prompt and AGENTS.md Section 56 enforce zero background server policy.
